title: Taking over the Common Rules chat v1 work

C1.rule: Mechanical, one owned file, fully specified, no design choice

C2.rule: Bounded implementation or tests, clear spec, one or two owned files and their tests

C3.rule: Cross-module design; changes a gate or the ledger contract; wrong means every project inherits it

C4.rule: Planning, merging, reconciling, anything in a project's real data, a sponsor decision

phases.name: Takeover
phases.goal: Everything the Common Rules chat v1 session left open is tracked here, landed or handed to its owner, so that session can be deleted without losing work.
phases.exit: K-01 to K-06 done or blocked with an owner; K-07 decided by the sponsor.

phases.name: Research
phases.goal: Questions that need reading, not writing, before they become items, a proposal, or a decline.
phases.exit: Every X row is done only when it becomes items, a numbered proposal, or a recorded decline with the reason -- never a report nobody acted on.

items.title: Land p22 on main
items.what: origin/p22 carries proposal 22's T-01 to T-03 (21 commits, 24 files, +2614/-228, last commit 9ae271f). Merge origin/main into it: keep set and ask in bin/tracker's COMMANDS; regenerate the handover checkpoint and tracker pages. Full suite through bin/quiet, a reviewer (common-rules is restricted), merge once. Afterwards ledger 22 is owned by this session.
